units.source_text: 薰君看了大女公子的回信，

en.t: Kaoru read the elder princess's reply,

units.source_text: 觉得笔迹清秀悦目，措词天真诚恳，深为赞善。

en.t: and found the handwriting elegant and pleasing, the wording innocent and sincere, and he praised it highly.

units.source_text: 大女公子的侍女们告诉八亲王，

en.t: The elder princess's ladies-in-waiting told Prince Hachi,

units.source_text: 说“薰中将有信给大小姐”，

en.t: saying, "Lieutenant General Kaoru has sent a letter for the young lady,"

units.source_text: 八亲王看了信，

en.t: Prince Hachi read the letter,

units.source_text: 说道：“此信无关紧要。

en.t: and said, "This letter is of no great consequence.

units.source_text: 你们把它看作情书，反而误解了。

en.t: You have mistaken it by treating it as a love letter.

units.source_text: 这位中将和普通青年男子不同，心地正大光明。

en.t: This lieutenant general is unlike ordinary young men; his heart is upright and open.

units.source_text: 我曾隐约向他表示身后有所嘱托的意思，

en.t: I once hinted to him that I had matters to entrust to him after my death,

units.source_text: 所以他如此关心吧。”

en.t: so that must be why he shows such concern."

units.source_text: 八亲王自己也写信去谢他，

en.t: Prince Hachi himself also wrote to thank him,

units.source_text: 信中有“承赐种种珍品，山中岩屋几乎容不下了”等语。

en.t: and in the letter he wrote words such as, "You have bestowed so many rare gifts that my rocky hut in the mountains can scarcely contain them."

units.source_text: 薰君便思量再赴宇治访问。

en.t: Kaoru then considered going to Uji for another visit.

units.source_text: 又想：“三皇子曾对我说：‘住在深山中的女子，

en.t: He also thought, "The Third Prince once said to me, 'A woman living deep in the mountains,

units.source_text: 如果长得特别漂亮，倒是极有意思的事。’

en.t: if she were especially beautiful, would be a most fascinating thing.'

units.source_text: 他抱着这种幻想。

en.t: He cherishes that sort of fantasy.

units.source_text: 我不妨把情状告诉他，刺激他一下，

en.t: I may as well tell him how things are and stir him a little,

units.source_text: 叫他心绪不得安宁。”

en.t: so that his heart will not be at peace."

units.source_text: 便在一个闲静的傍晚前往访问。

en.t: So he went to visit on a quiet, leisurely evening.

units.source_text: 照例讲了种种闲话之后，

en.t: After they had chatted about various idle matters as usual,

units.source_text: 薰君提起宇治八亲王的话，

en.t: Kaoru brought up the subject of Prince Hachi of Uji,

units.source_text: 详细叙述那天破晓时分窥见两女公子容颜的事。

en.t: and described in detail how he had glimpsed the faces of the two princesses at dawn that day.

units.source_text: 匂皇子听了大感兴趣。

en.t: Prince Niou listened and became deeply interested.

units.source_text: 薰君心里想，果然不出所料。

en.t: Kaoru thought to himself that it was just as he had expected.

units.source_text: 便继续描述，借以激动其心。

en.t: So he continued describing them, using his words to excite the prince's heart.

units.source_text: 匂皇子恨恨地说：“那么她给你的回信，你何不给我看看呢？

en.t: Prince Niou said resentfully, "Then why will you not show me the reply she sent you?

units.source_text: 要是我，早已给你看了。”

en.t: If it were me, I would have shown it to you long ago."

units.source_text: 薰君答道：“哪里！

en.t: Kaoru answered, "Not at all!

units.source_text: 你收到了各种各样女子写来的信，连一片纸也不曾给我看过呢！

en.t: You have received letters from all sorts of women, yet you have never shown me even a single scrap of paper!

units.source_text: 总之，这两位小姐，不是像我这种门外汉所能独占的，

en.t: In any case, these two young ladies are not the sort that an outsider like me could keep to myself,

units.source_text: 我想非请你去看一看不可。

en.t: and I feel I must have you go and see them.

units.source_text: 然而照你的身份，如何去得呢？

en.t: But given your rank, how could you possibly go?

units.source_text: 世间只有微贱的人，如果好色，才可恣意寻花问柳。

en.t: In this world, only lowly men, if they are amorous, can wander freely in pursuit of women.

units.source_text: 埋没着的美人多得很呢！

en.t: There are so many hidden beauties buried away from sight!

units.source_text: 像这种看得上眼的女子，沉思冥想地闲坐在荒僻地方的屋子里，

en.t: A woman pleasing to the eye, sitting quietly in thought in a house in some remote place,

units.source_text: 正是在山乡地方才会意想不到地遇上。

en.t: is just the kind one unexpectedly encounters in a mountain village.

units.source_text: 我刚才所说的两个女子，生长在遗世独立的圣僧一般的人家。

en.t: The two women I just mentioned grew up in a household like that of a holy monk living apart from the world.

units.source_text: 多年来我总以为毫无风趣，一向看她们不起。

en.t: For years I assumed they had no charm at all and always looked down on them.

units.source_text: 人家谈起时我连听也不要听。

en.t: When people spoke of them, I would not even listen.

units.source_text: 岂知完全不然，如果那天月光之夜没有看错，

en.t: Who would have known it was entirely otherwise? If I did not mistake what I saw that moonlit night,

units.source_text: 竟是十全无缺的美人。

en.t: they were in fact flawless beauties.

units.source_text: 无论相貌和姿态，都生得非常姣好，

en.t: In both face and bearing, they were born extraordinarily lovely,

units.source_text: 真可说是合乎理想的佳人。”

en.t: and they may truly be called ideal beauties."

units.source_text: 匂皇子听到末了，真心地妒羡起来。

en.t: By the time Prince Niou had listened to the end, he was genuinely envious and jealous.

units.source_text: 他想：“薰君这个人对于寻常女子向来是不动心的。

en.t: He thought, "Kaoru is a man who has never been moved by ordinary women.

units.source_text: 如今他这等赞美，可知这两个女子一定颇不平凡。”

en.t: Since he praises them so highly now, these two women must certainly be quite extraordinary."

units.source_text: 便对她们发生了无限恋慕之情。

en.t: Thus he developed an unlimited longing for them.

units.source_text: 他劝薰君：“请你再去仔细看看好吗？”

en.t: He urged Kaoru, "Would you please go again and look at them carefully?"

units.source_text: 他对于自己不能自由行动的高贵身份，竟觉得讨厌起来。

en.t: He even began to resent his own noble rank, which kept him from moving about freely.

units.source_text: 薰君看了心里好笑，答道：“不好，这种事情干不得。

en.t: Kaoru found this amusing and replied, "No, that sort of thing must not be done.

units.source_text: 我已立志，对世俗之事，即使暂时也不可关心。

en.t: I have already resolved that I must not concern myself with worldly affairs, even for a moment.

units.source_text: 逢场作戏的事我也决不染指。

en.t: I will never involve myself even in passing flirtations.

units.source_text: 如果自己不能控制此心，就大大地违背我的本愿了。”

en.t: If I cannot control my own heart, I will have gravely betrayed my deepest vow."

units.source_text: 匂皇子笑道：“啊唷，好神气啊！

en.t: Prince Niou laughed and said, "Oh my, how lofty you sound!

units.source_text: 你总是得道高僧似的一篇大道理。

en.t: You are always preaching grand principles like an enlightened high priest.

units.source_text: 且看你熬得到几时。”

en.t: Let us see how long you can hold out."

units.source_text: 实际上，薰君心中一直挂念着那老侍女隐约提到的那件事。

en.t: In truth, Kaoru had all along been preoccupied with the matter that the old lady-in-waiting had vaguely mentioned.

units.source_text: 他对此事比以前更加关心，又很感伤。

en.t: He cared about it even more than before, and it made him deeply melancholy.

units.source_text: 因此即使自己看到美人，或者听人说起某家女儿长得漂亮，

en.t: Therefore, even if he saw a beautiful woman himself, or heard someone say that some family's daughter was lovely,

units.source_text: 他也全然不放在心上。

en.t: he paid it no attention at all.
